primaryContract: PRD R4 §8.2 and AFS-01..03; native owner and management cases, immutable line allocation, explicit returns and verified monetary facts.
interaction: Management: shared text tabs for all/review/returns/refunds/closed, compact summaries, case detail and action-specific native sheet. Server-derived unshipped eligibility allows request_refund for either case kind before dispatch or return. approveRefund=true atomically links the buyer request and current administrator money approval, retaining self/beneficiary/exception separation; the worker dispatches asynchronously. Approval is not verified success. Return address instructions are versioned and delivered to the linked support conversation.
recovery: Single in-flight mutation, original key and frozen payload for foreground uncertain retries. Hide clears personal content, preserves only reconciliation-needed state. Fresh case read and explicit acknowledgement required before a new operation. Server versions, ordered row locks and unique active claim protect concurrent paths.
authority: Separate commerce.aftersale.review, commerce.return.receive and commerce.return.inspect. Money approval still requires commerce.refund.approve and formal command authorization. Owner cannot review own case. Six-second visible management polling removes revoked capabilities; server checks on every action are authoritative.
privacy: Read own case or capability-limited management view only. Public-to-customer handling notes must not contain unrelated persons or internal secrets. Deployment approval reference is excluded from the contact projection. No device persistence of case contents, no cross-account late response, no cacheable API response. New objects are mapped as unapproved for general privacy export/erasure.
visual: Existing CISME native tokens and safe-area chrome; shared section-tabs, compact white summaries with 12px corners, stable cold skeletons, preserved confirmed nodes during refresh, no outlined secondary controls or loading prose. Detail actions reveal only their required fields in a scrollable sheet.
limits: No fabricated payment, dispatch or return facts; no automatic inventory restock or eligibility determination. Existing partial allocation is preserved. Full native matrix and physical-device evidence remain unaccepted.
